lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Laws for Sharing the Road — Bikes, Trucks & Horses
prompt: Under Texas Transportation Code §545.308, what is the required conduct when encountering horseback riders?

options.text: Reduce speed, do not sound horn or rev engine, and pass with extreme caution
Sound your horn repeatedly to alert the animal of your approaching vehicle
Accelerate quickly to clear the corridor before the animal enters the lane
Animals are illegal on Texas state roadways and drivers owe zero duties
